_about: Documented timeline and resources for the Pedrógão Grande fire, 17–19 June 2017. Times are local (WEST). 't' = hours since 2017-06-17 00:00. Sources: Observador minute-by-minute (resources reported by ANPC to the press), SGIF/ICNF records, Leiria court ruling (downburst), IPMA (dry thunderstorm).

300 bombeiros e 101 veículos
